parameters.query:
WITH parametros AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(TRIM($1::TEXT), '') AS ciudad,
        NULLIF(TRIM($2::TEXT), '') AS pais
),

mercado_pais AS (
    SELECT
        cc.iso2,
        cc.iso3,
        cc.country_name,
        cc.official_name,
        cc.market_type,
        cc.commercial_scope,
        cc.priority_tier,
        cc.priority_weight,
        cc.calling_codes,
        cc.cc_tlds,
        cc.currency_codes,
        cc.language_codes
    FROM country_context cc
    CROSS JOIN parametros p
    WHERE
        cc.is_active = TRUE
        AND cc.prospecting_enabled = TRUE
        AND p.pais IS NOT NULL
        AND (
            LOWER(TRIM(cc.iso2::TEXT)) = LOWER(TRIM(p.pais))

            OR LOWER(TRIM(cc.country_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(p.pais))

            OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM unnest(cc.aliases) AS alias_value
                WHERE LOWER(TRIM(alias_value)) = LOWER(TRIM(p.pais))
            )
        )
    LIMIT 1
),

candidatos AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM rhia_resolve_location(
        (SELECT ciudad FROM parametros),
        (SELECT pais FROM parametros),
        10
    )
)

SELECT

    $4::JSONB AS contexto_original,

    $3::TEXT AS empresa_mencionada,

    COALESCE($1::TEXT, '') AS ciudad_entrada,

    COALESCE($2::TEXT, '') AS pais_entrada,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT TO_JSONB(m)
            FROM mercado_pais m
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        '{}'::JSONB
    ) AS mercado_pais,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                TO_JSONB(c)
                ORDER BY
                    c.location_score DESC,
                    c.population DESC
            )
            FROM candidatos c
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS candidatos_geograficos;
